'''Brakan Mesa''' was one of the many [[mesa]]s that made up the habitable surface on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]], rising many kilometers from the planet-wide [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]. It was joined to the [[Aboro Mesa]] by a [[light bridge]].
